tagline: Sandboxes, isolated runtimes and secure execution environments where AI agents run code and browse safely.
scope: It is about isolated execution for AI agents, not a general container or VM product with no agent story.
heroAlt: Animated isometric scene: a control block sends job packets down a lane into a row of glass-walled rooms on pedestals, where each room raises its walls around an agent cube, prints code on its floor, then sinks its walls and clears.
